excerpt_policy: Each record stores a short whitespace-normalized excerpt copied verbatim from the public source page named in source_url, retrieved on the created_at date above. search_aliases are terms observed verbatim on the same source page (common-names list, excerpt, or references) and are used for lexical matching only; they are not source content. Verify the source site's terms before any redistribution beyond this prototype.
retrieval_notes: Prototype corpus: 3 verified Feedipedia (INRAE/CIRAD/AFZ/FAO) excerpts on livestock feeding. Coverage is narrow by design; most questions will correctly trigger the insufficient-evidence path.
